title: Cindy J NDE 7523
content: Extreme fear before losing consciousness. Then slowly faded to black. Then I was jolted awake and was moving down tunnel very fast. The noise in the tunnel very loud. I was moving down the tunnel toward white light. I was passing through a membrane or curtain into white light and at same time felt myself disintegrate into atoms or particles and become one with the white light. This sensation was accompanied by the most amazing overwhelming feeling of love, joy, happiness, and UNION with everything. Then the movement stopped and I found myself standing very still in an ORB of white light, a circular space of light. This space was filled with about 15 Beings of white light. They were not material or recognizable in our sense of physical bodies, but I could recognize them clearly and could communicate without words. Some of these beings I recognized clearly as they were relatives that had passed. The one at the front, who communicated with me, was my maternal grandmother. Another one was my paternal Grandfather. There were other deceased beings there too, some whom I knew of but had not met. For instance, like my Godfather and a workmate's son who had recently died aged 22 of cancer. Also there was a large male person in the left hand corner of the group who I knew to be a guardian or great-grandfather and that he was Aboriginal. He said he was watching over me. After some time, my Grandmother told me I had to return to earth. She said that she was going to put me 'in the oven till fully baked.' I begged to stay. I jolted awake at the hospital and then lost consciousness again intermittently for about a week. Each time I came-to, I was upset to be back in this horrible, gritty world where everybody looked like rotting fruit. It took a while for this repulsion to wear off, but it did eventually. I still think about this experience every day I live.

arrival.other_being_detail: A "large male person" identified as a guardian or great-grandfather who was Aboriginal; he said he was watching over her.

environment.environment_other_detail: An "ORB of white light, a circular space of light."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Passing through a "membrane or curtain" and "disintegrate into atoms or particles" becoming one with the white light; later in an "ORB of white light" with ~15 beings of white light.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Fear/blackness → tunnel with loud noise and white light → membrane/curtain and disintegration/union with light → stationary orb of white light with beings → told to return → jolt awake in hospital.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Passing through the membrane/curtain into white light occurred "at same time" as disintegrating into particles and becoming one with the white light.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Passing through a "membrane or curtain"; feeling of disintegrating into atoms/particles and becoming one with the white light; grandmother said she would put her "in the oven till fully baked"; post-return perception of the world as "horrible, gritty" and people like "rotting fruit."

"Then the movement stopped and I found myself standing very still in an ORB of white light, a circular space of light." "She said that she was going to put me 'in the oven till fully baked.'" "Each time I came-to, I was upset to be back in this horrible, gritty world where everybody looked like rotting fruit."
